blockNote: North (negative $24) vertical-phase collision dispatch, wall handlers and north slope physics (184376-184902, Bank 02). DispatchNorthMove is called once per tick by PlayerMovementTick after the horizontal phase; the mirror image for positive $24 is DispatchSouthMove in player_move_south.
=== CONVENTIONS ===

Positions are sub-pixels (4 per pixel; a 16-px tile is 64, so AND #$FFC0 floors to a row line). $24 / $26 are the Y velocity / position (negative = north, Y grows downward) and $22 is X. $1A / $1E are the probe pixel X / Y and $00 is the map index of the last probe; MapCellUp / Down / Left / Right read $00 and return the new index in X only (a caller that wants to keep it does STX $00; a result that is not stored is lost). CheckSubTileAlignX / Y: carry CLEAR = the probe sits on a 16-px line (flush), carry SET = it straddles two cells. Probe types: $02 ladder, $08 vine, $0E and above solid, $03 / $0C slopes; $06 / $09 are undecoded wall-like types (audit OQ-16, OQ-I029-5), so 'south wall' / 'north wall' below are handler names, not directions.
=== DISPATCH ORDER (DispatchNorthMove) ===
1. ProbeCurrentTL (carry set only): $06 -> SouthWallHandler, $03 -> NorthSlopeRight, $0C -> NorthSlopeLeft; any other type falls on.
2. ProbeCurrentTR: $09 -> NorthWallHandler.
3. ProbeFutureTL (top-left after the step): $0E and above or $08 -> blocked path; $02 -> NorthInteractTile; $06 -> SouthWallNudge.

4. CheckSubTileAlignX. X flush: future TL $09 -> NorthProbeRedirect, anything else -> the plain step. X straddling: future TL $09 -> blocked path; otherwise MapCellRight (the future TR cell) is read: $0E and above, $08, $02 or $06 -> blocked path, $09 -> NorthProbeRedirect, anything else -> the plain step.
5. Plain step: $26 += $24 (Y shrinks). $22 and $20 are not touched; PlayerMovementTick commits the position afterwards.

6. Blocked path (loc_02D0AF): SetActorCollisionFlag, AutoAlignEW (nudge X onto the column grid, carry clear = nudged), then SnapYNorthCollision. After a nudge the Y snap runs without zeroing playerSpeedNs (entry loc_02D0C2), so the player keeps pushing and is walked around the corner a couple of pixels per tick.
The older header had step 4 reversed ('sub-tile aligned: MapCellRight'); the code runs the MapCellRight probe only when X is NOT flush.
=== SNAPPING ===

SnapYNorthCollision: Y' = $24 + $26 (the stepped Y), floored to a row line and moved one row down: $26 = (Y' AND $FFC0) + $40, $24 = 0. The hitbox top (feet - 16 px) then sits flush under the blocking row. In the normal blocked case Y' lies north of the old Y and the result falls between Y' and Y, so it backs the player off the step. Callers that run with $24 parked at 0 (the east and west wall-slide handlers) push the player SOUTH by 1..16 px instead (16 when already flush). The full entry also zeroes playerSpeedNs.
=== SLOPES ===

NorthSlopeRight ($03) and NorthSlopeLeft ($0C) are entered when the current TL has that type and need the current TR to match, else the move counts as blocked. The slope flag $09AF bit $10 (playerFlags $1000, on a slope) is set when Y is flush, when the cell below has the same type, or when d >= 8. Here d = 16 - n and n = (($26 + $24) >> 2) AND $0F is the row offset of the top probe inside the slope tile, so d >= 8 means the upper half of the tile; in the lower half (n >= 9, d < 8) the move is applied without the flag. The old text called d < 8 the 'upper half'. The slope directions ('right' / 'left') are undecoded (OQ-I033-3); the old part notes called the same types 'descending' and 'ascending' inconsistently.

NorthSlopeLeft additionally filters the step through slopeFracAccum ($09C6, shared with the south handlers): a positive leftover is zeroed, then accum += $24. With |accum| >> 4 = 0 the unchanged $24 is applied and accum keeps the sum. Otherwise $24 is REPLACED by -(|accum| >> 4) and accum gains 16 per step. Nothing subtracts the distance that was actually moved, so for $24 = -8 the player alternates a full 2-px step and a 1-sub-pixel step (about 56 percent of the speed on average). UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME.
=== WALL HANDLERS ===

SouthWallHandler (current TL $06) and NorthWallHandler (current TR $09): if the opposite bottom corner (BR / BL) has the same type the player is enclosed and ClearMovementDeltas runs. Otherwise the future corner is probed and CheckSubTileAlignY decides. Y STRADDLING and future type $06 / $09: gap chain. Y flush, or another type: the snap path.

Gap chain: the neighbour cell east (SouthWallHandler, MapCellRight) or west (NorthWallHandler, MapCellLeft) of the future corner cell and the cell below that neighbour must both be type 0, else ClearSpeedNS_1 / _2 (playerSpeedNs = 0, nothing applied this tick). Both empty: ComputeYSnapOffset, then FineAdjustXWest / FineAdjustXEast. FineAdjustXWest moves X EAST and FineAdjustXEast moves X WEST (the names refer to the wall side), so SouthWallHandler slides the player east and NorthWallHandler west; the old headers said the opposite.

Snap path: SnapXDiagCollision (SouthWallHandler: X to the centre of the next column east, also zeroes playerSpeedEw) or SnapXEastCollision (NorthWallHandler: X floored to its column centre, i.e. west), then the future corner is re-probed. Still $06 / $09: take the slide. Anything else: zero $24 (so SnapYSouthCollision floors the CURRENT Y with no step added) and apply the move.

SouthWallNudge (future TL $06): $AB bit 1 is set by DispatchDiagDownLeft in every tick where the west horizontal phase ran (a negative $20) and is cleared together with $AA at the start of the tick; the old text called it a 'wall interaction flag from a prior collision pass'. If it is set and X is flush, the north step is cancelled ($24 = 0) and the X move is applied. Otherwise MapCellRight from the future TL cell: $0E and above -> zero $24 + SnapYSouthCollision + apply (loc_02D1BC); anything else -> the SouthWallHandler gap chain.

NorthProbeRedirect: reached from DispatchNorthMove when future TL is $09 (X flush) or the east cell is $09. Its MapCellDown + ReadCollisionNibble have no effect (MapCellDown only changes X, the nibble is dropped and MapCellLeft at loc_02D208 reads $00 again), so the chain starts from the cell recorded in $00 (OQ-I039-4).
Everything here is UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME (no emulator trace); the arithmetic is read from the code.

DispatchNorthMove: Entry for negative $24, 8-bit probe mode, called from PlayerMovementTick after the horizontal phase. Probe order, the plain step and the blocked path are described in the block note; exits are JMPs into the slope / wall handlers, the plain step (loc_02D0A5) or the blocked path (loc_02D0AF).
SnapYNorthCollision: Y snap after a blocked north step: $26 = (($24 + $26) AND $FFC0) + $40, $24 = 0, so the hitbox top ends flush under the blocking row. The full entry zeroes playerSpeedNs first; the loc_02D0C2 entry (used after a successful AutoAlignEW nudge) keeps it. With $24 = 0 (east / west wall-slide callers) it pushes south by 1..16 px. See the block note.
NorthInteractTile: Type $02 ladder ahead while moving north (a local label inside DispatchNorthMove). CheckSubTileAlignX: X straddling (carry set) -> blocked path. X flush: the player actor's entry becomes LadderClimbSouth (the ladder state entered from below: it checks Up before Down, then LadderIdleNorth) and $0008 = 0; then the blocked path runs, which holds the player at the ladder base.
NorthSlopeRight: Current TL $03 while moving north. Needs the current TR to be $03 too, else blocked path. Y flush, or the cell below also $03: set the slope flag and apply. Otherwise d = 16 - n (see the block note): d < 8 applies the move without the flag, d >= 8 sets $09AF bit $10 first. The direction of the slope is undecoded (OQ-I033-3).
NorthSlopeLeft: Current TL $0C while moving north. Same gate and flag logic as NorthSlopeRight, but with d < 8 the move is applied without touching the accumulator; otherwise the flag is set and the step goes through the slopeFracAccum filter (block note): the full $24 when |accum + $24| < 16, else -(|accum + $24| >> 4). For $24 = -8 the steps alternate -8 and -1 sub-pixels. UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME.
SouthWallHandler: Current TL $06 while moving north. Current BR $06 too: ClearMovementDeltas. Otherwise ProbeFutureTL + CheckSubTileAlignY. Y straddling and future TL $06: gap chain (loc_02D19E): the east cell and the cell below it must both be type 0, else ClearSpeedNS_1; both empty: ComputeYSnapOffset + FineAdjustXWest (X moves EAST). Y flush or another type: SnapXDiagCollision (X east to the next column centre), re-probe; $06 -> slide, else zero $24 + SnapYSouthCollision + apply.
SouthWallNudge: Future TL $06 while moving north. $AB bit 1 (the west horizontal phase ran this tick) with X flush: $24 = 0 and the X move is applied. Otherwise MapCellRight from the future TL cell: $0E and above -> loc_02D1BC (zero $24, SnapYSouthCollision, apply); anything else -> the SouthWallHandler gap chain at loc_02D19E (which cancels on any nonzero type).
ClearSpeedNS_1: Abort of the SouthWallHandler gap chain: playerSpeedNs = 0 and return. No position is applied this tick ($26 stays as it was).
NorthWallHandler: Current TR $09 while moving north. Current BL $09 too: ClearMovementDeltas. Otherwise ProbeFutureTR + CheckSubTileAlignY. Y straddling and future TR $09: gap chain (loc_02D208): the west cell and the cell below it must both be type 0, else ClearSpeedNS_2; both empty: ComputeYSnapOffset + FineAdjustXEast (X moves WEST). Y flush or another type: SnapXEastCollision (X floored to its column centre, west), re-probe; $09 -> slide, else zero $24 + SnapYSouthCollision + apply.
NorthProbeRedirect: Entry from DispatchNorthMove when the future TL is $09 (X flush) or the east cell is $09. MapCellDown + ReadCollisionNibble here are dead (the result is unused and the BRA target's MapCellLeft starts from $00), so it simply joins the NorthWallHandler gap chain at loc_02D208 with the cell in $00 (OQ-I039-4).
ClearSpeedNS_2: Abort of the NorthWallHandler gap chain: playerSpeedNs = 0 and return. No position is applied this tick.

blockNote: Breakable-wall debris effect: a one-shot actor that spawns 8 child particle actors and dies. Each pass waits WaitByte(3) (the runner skips 3 passes, so 4 frames) and spawns DebrisBurstParticle with COP SpawnAfterFlags, initial $10 flags $0302; LoopEnd yields once more per pass, so one particle appears every 5 frames and the burst lasts about 40 frames (static reading, UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME).

DebrisBurstParticle: spriteset_enemies metasprite, palette 0, priority #30. CopyActorState gives it the burst actor's position; $14 / $16 then get two independent RNG offsets of -16 .. +15 px (RngByte AND $1F, minus $10). It plays sound #$0F on both channels (PlaySoundBoth #$0F0F, so all eight particles play the crumble sound), stages sprite frame #01, runs AnimOnce and dies. Flags $0302: bit $0200 is part of the combat_collision skip masks (OQ-I030-2); $0100 and $0002 are undecoded.

Spawn sites (4): dm3D_breakable_wall (Diamond Mine, flags $2000), gw83_switch (Great Wall, $2000), it19_breakable_wall (Itory cave, SpawnAfterAbsFlags at (152, 96), $2000) and dm40_trapped_slave (Diamond Mine, $3000). The older header named only the first two. docs/code/bank00/functions-camera-motion.md describes the routine as an LDX #8 / JSR random / DEX loop with offsets of +-$10 .. +-$30 pixels; the code is a COP LoopStart / LoopEnd script and the offsets are -16 .. +15 px.

SpawnDebrisBurst: Burst actor: LoopStart #08, then per pass WaitByte #03, SpawnAfterFlags DebrisBurstParticle with $10 = $0302, LoopEnd (yields while the counter is nonzero); after the eighth pass it dies. One particle every 5 frames (4 wait + 1 LoopEnd yield).
DebrisBurstParticle: One debris particle: spriteset_enemies metasprite, palette 0, priority #30; X and Y each move by an independent random -16 .. +15 px from the inherited burst position; plays sound #$0F on both channels, shows frame #01 once (AnimOnce) and dies.

blockNote: Called with JSL by cutscene actors (17 call sites in 14 actor files: st68_lily, dc31_kara, it15_lola, it15_lily, av74_kara, btDF_kara, btDE_olman, btDE_monologue, ir1C_lily, na4B_lily, sc06_lily, sc06_kara, dm43_elevator, sc02_seth) to put the player into an idle pose facing a chosen direction before scripted movement.

Input: A (16-bit) = facing index 0 South, 1 North, 2 West, 3 East (the order of player_idle_entry_table and of GetPlayerFacingDirection); there is no range check. X is set to the player actor slot from $playerActor ($09AA). The routine writes the entry pointer of that actor: $0000,X = the IdleStand* word from the table, $0002,X = the bank byte of IdleStandSouth. The player's script therefore resumes in the idle pose on its next run. It also zeroes the wait counter $0008 and the movement scratch words $002C / $002E, both in the actor's DP page and in the extended data ($7F002C / $7F002E).

The caller's X is saved with PHX / PLX; Y is untouched; A is clobbered. The old header's 'frame counter' is the wait counter $08. docs/code/bank00/data-tables-memory.md says the table is selected 'based on body form and scene context'; the routine looks only at A (the IdleStand* handlers themselves branch on the Shadow flag byte #00).

InitPlayerScriptVariant: Sets the player actor's script entry to IdleStandSouth / North / West / East chosen by A (0..3), resets the wait counter and the movement scratch words, and returns with RTL. See the block note.
player_idle_entry_table: Four word entries (50960-50967) indexed by A * 2: IdleStandSouth, IdleStandNorth, IdleStandWest, IdleStandEast (the same order as GetPlayerFacingDirection: 0 down, 1 up, 2 left, 3 right). Read with a long-indexed load; all four handlers share one bank.
